rationale: The workflow already implements key optimizations: concurrency with cancel-in-progress (P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE), a job-level timeout-minutes (P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT/P-LIT-HISTORY-TIMEOUT), and a matrix strategy. The remaining candidate, P-LIT-FAIL-FAST (changing fail-fast from false to true), is contraindicated because each matrix outcome (Julia version build) is required for downstream TestAsserts workflow; cancelling remaining downloads on a single failure would reduce test coverage. P-LIT-GHA-CACHE does not cleanly apply because the workflow downloads versioned build artifacts from Buildkite (authenticated, not reproducible dependency fetches), and the artifacts are already uploaded for reuse. No other pattern from the catalogue fits this workflow's structure and constraints without weakening required checks or introducing unsupported changes.
